verdict.rationale: There is thin, indirect evidence of custom controls. Oneleet's Fieldwork page invites users to "Describe your control" and have AI agents collect and validate evidence for it, and the framework-removal docs note that controls can hold "custom content" and evidence. Nothing documents creating custom frameworks or defining your own automated tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones. Missing for 10: documented custom framework creation, explicit custom control creation workflow, user-defined tests, user-defined evidence requirements, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones

citations.quote: Describe your control. Fieldwork’s AI agents collect, validate, and package the evidence – across your enterprise systems, on your schedule.
Controls stay when another framework requires them or when they contain work such as evidence, review history, assignments, or custom content.
